description: There are rough silvery areas near my hairline and the ends of a few fingernails have little dents.
A small patch on my forearm has spread out into a ring with a rough rim and the skin inside looks clearer.
After I wake up my eyelids feel sticky and I have to clean crust from the base of my lashes.
The letters in the middle of a page jump out of shape but the edges of the page still look normal.
My voice sounds like a whisper after a cold and I keep clearing my throat.
I can hear the television but struggle to make out the conversation when several people are speaking.
My pulse suddenly goes very fast while I am sitting down. A few minutes later it goes back to normal.
I need extra pillows because I get short of breath when I lie flat. My shoes have also become tight around the ankles.
I have had a dry cough for months and walking uphill now makes me stop to catch my breath.
I keep getting chest infections and cough up a lot of phlegm first thing in the morning.
For weeks I have had to rush to the toilet with loose stools and now I sometimes see blood and slime mixed in.
Both water and solid food feel stuck on the way down. Sometimes food I ate earlier comes back up undigested.
Several times a day I get brief stabbing bursts on one cheek as if an electric current went through it when I brush my teeth.
My feet feel like they are burning and I have started stumbling because I cannot feel the floor well.
The stiffness across my lower back is worst when I get out of bed and gets better after a walk.
A whole toe has puffed up like a sausage and I have small pits in my nails and flaky patches on my scalp.
My knee swelled after I turned sharply during football and it catches when I try to straighten it.
The first few steps to the bathroom in the morning hurt under my heel. It eases once I have been walking for a while.
I pass urine normally most of the time but a little leaks out when I laugh or sneeze.
My bladder feels painfully full and I keep going to the toilet. Emptying it only helps for a little while.
I am passing much less urine than I usually do and my legs have swollen on both sides over the last few days.
I have a background of kidney problems and lately I have been itchy all over and get muscle cramps that wake me up.
I eat just as much as before but my belt is getting looser. I feel too warm and my hands shake.
My rings no longer fit and I have moved up two shoe sizes as an adult. My hands seem noticeably larger than before.
My periods are heavier than they used to be and I feel pressure low in my pelvis between periods.
I noticed a little pink spotting even though I have gone two years without a period.
Whenever I stay overnight at a house with a cat my eyes start watering and I cannot stop sneezing.
I ate a snack and shortly afterwards the inside of my mouth started itching and my lips puffed up.
I am unusually pale and exhausted. Walking across the room makes me feel out of breath and my heart thump.
I have had repeated infections and keep finding bruises that I cannot explain. I also have very little energy.
I am short of breath climbing a single flight of stairs and sometimes get an uncomfortable pressure in my chest.
My eyes turn red and water after I spend time outside on warm windy days.
I get itchy raised patches on my arms after using a new skin product.
I noticed blood in my urine and a dull ache just below the ribs on one side.
How can I merge two cells without losing the contents?
Where do I change the folder used for downloads?
I am vomiting, I have a fever, and I have a dry cough.
